laws.k: countries-of-origin|BD|Recruiting Agents Licence and Conduct Rules 2019
laws.t: Recruiting Agents Licence and Conduct Rules 2019
laws.s2: Mengatur agen dan sub-agen perekrutan beserta sanksinya.

coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Recruiting agents need a licence and a security deposit and may be sanctioned; the Act and the 2019 Rules regulate sub-agents, but agents are not made jointly liable for the employer's obligations.

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: The government sets a maximum migration cost for each destination (for example for Saudi Arabia and Malaysia); charging more is an offense.

coded.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
coded.vl: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
coded.n: Emigration clearance requires an employment contract with stated terms, attested by the mission where required.

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Pre-departure briefing is required for clearance; longer training is required for women going into domestic work; whether all of it is free to the worker is not established.

coded.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vl: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
coded.n: The Wage Earners' Welfare Fund, financed by compulsory contributions, pays death and disability benefits, repatriation of bodies and legal assistance.

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
coded.vl: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
coded.n: The Act provides for labor welfare wings in missions in destination countries.

coded.vi: Badan khusus di dalam negeri dapat memberi ganti rugi kepada pekerja terhadap perekrut (dan majikan asing) atas pelanggaran selama rekrutmen atau kerja
coded.vl: A specialized body at home can award compensation to workers against recruiters (and employers abroad) for breaches during recruitment or employment
coded.n: A worker may complain to the government, which may settle the matter by arbitration and order compensation; offenses can also be prosecuted.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
coded.vl: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
coded.n: Women going abroad for domestic work must be at least 25 (with an upper age limit in some recruitment rounds); the rule applies to women only. Current wording to be confirmed with BMET.
coded.src: BMET guidelines; Daily Star and Financial Express reports

coded.vi: Undang-undang memberi badan publik kewajiban menyediakan layanan reintegrasi (kerja, keuangan, psikososial) bagi pekerja yang pulang
coded.vl: A statute assigns a public body the duty to provide reintegration services (employment, financial, psychosocial) to returning workers
coded.n: The Wage Earners' Welfare Board has statutory functions on rehabilitation and reintegration; Probashi Kallyan Bank provides reintegration loans.
coded.src: Wage Earners' Welfare Board Act 2018; OEMP 2016

coded.fn: Departure without sex, age or destination bans
coded.vl: Age floor above 18, family conditions, or bans on some destinations
coded.n: Minimum age 25 for women domestic workers.
coded.src: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013; Government order

dec.n: Md. Sadaqat Khan (Fakku) v. Chief Election Commissioner
dec.ct: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
dec.pe: Urdu-speaking people who stayed in Bangladesh after 1971 lived for decades in camps without recognition as citizens. The High Court said they are citizens and must be allowed to vote.
dec.pi: Warga berbahasa Urdu yang tetap tinggal di Bangladesh setelah 1971 hidup puluhan tahun di kamp tanpa diakui sebagai warga negara. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan mereka warga negara dan berhak memilih.

dec.n: Writ on Bangladeshi workers who died on World Cup projects
dec.ct: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
dec.pe: A lawyer asked Bangladesh’s High Court to make the government account for workers who died or were hurt building stadiums abroad. The court ordered a list and asked about compensation. A higher judge paused part of the order.
dec.pi: Seorang advokat meminta Pengadilan Tinggi Bangladesh mewajibkan pemerintah mendata pekerja yang meninggal atau cedera saat membangun stadion di luar negeri. Pengadilan memerintahkan pendataan dan menanyakan ganti rugi. Hakim yang lebih tinggi menangguhkan sebagian perintah itu.
